# scc_teams_retention_compliance_rule (Resource)

Manages the TeamsRetentionComplianceRule object via New-TeamsRetentionComplianceRule / Get-TeamsRetentionComplianceRule / Set-TeamsRetentionComplianceRule / Remove-TeamsRetentionComplianceRule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.
- `policy` (String) Maps to the -Policy parameter.
- `retention_compliance_action` (String) Maps to the -RetentionComplianceAction parameter.
- `retention_duration` (String) Maps to the -RetentionDuration parameter.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
